Tile logic that copies plugin input fragments to an output dcache and republishes them by message kind.

# Purpose
This file defines the `plugin` tile for the `fd_stem` runtime. It receives fragments from several input links, classifies each input by link name, validates the message type for that input, and copies the payload into an output data cache chunk. The tile handles multiple plugin message kinds, including replay, gossip, stake, PoH, vote, start progress, vote leader, bundle, and validator config traffic. It also adjusts the copied size for message types that use a count field in the source payload, such as gossip updates, vote account updates, and stake weight messages.

The file also sets up the tile execution environment. The [`unprivileged_init`](<#unprivileged_init>) function maps each input and the single output link into workspace memory, computes compact data cache bounds, and stores the input kind for each link. The file defines the allowed seccomp policy and file descriptors for the tile, then connects the [`during_frag`](<#during_frag>) and [`after_frag`](<#after_frag>) callbacks to `fd_stem.c` through the `STEM_CALLBACK_*` macros. The exported `fd_tile_plugin` object registers this tile with the topology system so it can run as part of the larger pipeline.
